name: Michael Rigas
current_role: Deputy Secretary of State for Management and Resources; performing the duties of CEO of the U.S. Agency for Global Media (since March 2026)
summary: Michael Rigas is the State Department’s deputy secretary for management and resources, running its budget, staffing and operations. When Trump nominated Sarah Rogers to lead the U.S. Agency for Global Media in March 2026, Rigas was named to perform the agency’s CEO duties in the interim, over Kari Lake, who stayed on as deputy CEO.
